fusions.name: Flung Muck
fusions.desc: Flings muck that deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance of [Hindered] slowing the target's attacks for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Scatter Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks out in a wide cone 6 tiles long, dealing 14 damage to everything caught in it and knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Decoy Trot
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 8 seconds. While it lasts, a troop of monkeys fights beside you for 6 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spare Hands
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded macaque that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds against enemies within 5 tiles.
